items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: I remember him... you know this guy, what pop, they call him? Oh, that's Kid Ernest.

ctx.x: He's a big, fat fella now. I don't know. You know him, don't you?

I wanted to see the one who came here from, uh... Did he come from New Orleans over here to play? Mm-hmm. Yes, I remember him. But, uh, I'll tell you what, my sister, other sister, played with them. Mm-hmm. I tell you who, uh, you know this guy, what pop, they call him? Oh, that's Kid Ernest. No, that's, you know, he come here with Kid Ernest, I'm trying to say now. But not Kid Ernest. It was one of them big men that came in with him, Edmund, they went out to shorty, they played things out to shorty one, just a…
